observations.text: Route /blank is the logged-in home. Heading 'Flow with ideas'. Left sidebar lists New Flow, Flow Library, Media History, Knowledge Garden, Knowledge Market, a collapsible Projects group with 'Create new project', and a History list of flows (name + 'Last edit' date).

The composer is the single entry point; six mode chips (Chat, Image, Video, Slides, Website, Neo Agent) re-skin the same composer in place with no URL change. Chat shows 'Chat · GPT 4.1'; Image shows 'Image · Seedream 5.0 Pro' + Style, aspect ratio, image size, an 'Agent off' toggle, a locked 'Unlimited Mode'; Video shows Start frame / End frame / Loop keyframe slots; Neo Agent shows 'Auto · Neo Agent' + a MAX toggle and placeholder 'Describe a complex task for the Agent to handle...'.

The hidden file input's accept list changes with mode: Chat accepts .md/.txt/.json/.py/... text & code; Image accepts .jpg/.png/.webp/.heic. Evidence: DOM diff between home.default and home.mode-image state dumps.
Account shown as 'Tseka Luk · FREE' with credit balance 0 and a 'Get more credits' button. A persistent top banner advertises 'Unlock Unlimited Generation — GPT Image, Kling, Nano Banana & More'.

Below the composer: an 'Apps' rail of task-specific tools (Virtual Try-on, Social Post Maker, Background Remover, Photo Relighting, Image Upscaler, Editorial Poster, Crop & Resize, Wallpaper Generator, Furry Art Generator) and a category-filtered template gallery whose cards expose a 'Use' action on hover.

Submitting from the home composer creates a new flow (the History list items are flows and the Welcome flow's root node id equals its /conv/<uuid> route id) — confirmed later in canvas.new; see surfaces/canvas-new.
What 'Projects' contains (folders of flows vs something else) — not opened.
